Hi Samira —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Quantify is prioritizing lower-latency summaries for large multitenant datasets and wants predictable per-request economics. Per our convo, the right next step is a 60–90min technical deep-dive with your ML + infra leads so we can:

- Walk through a proposed serving architecture and latency tradeoffs
- Share our recommended batching/quantization profile for your workload
- Validate network/data residency constraints for private deployment
- Sketch a mutual action plan (owners + dates) to a pilot

To make scheduling simple I attached a short mutual action plan (QNT-MAP-v1.xlsx) and a draft agenda (redwood-tech-deep-dive-agenda.pdf). Can you confirm which of the options below work for your team and whether you prefer a 60- or 90-minute slot? All times shown in ET:

- Tue 27 Jun — 10:00–11:30 (90m) or 10:00–11:00 (60m)
- Thu 29 Jun — 14:00–15:30 (90m) or 14:00–15:00 (60m)
- Fri 30 Jun — 09:00–10:30 (90m) or 09:00–10:00 (60m)

Proposed Redwood attendees: me (AE), Marissa Cole (Solutions Eng) — model perf & evals, Connor O'Brien (Infra Eng) — networking/topology. Please let me know who from Quantify should join (ML lead, infra, security maybe), and if you have any hard blockers for the dates above.

If easier, I can send a Calendly poll (link below) and we can lock the slot.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this on the calendar.

— Ben
